sources.facts: StudioMilou Conservation Management Plan submitted to the Town Planning Board. Written sections 4.3 and 4.6 distinguish the main north porch and east/west wings, south verandahs, granite plinth, regular timber windows, profiled glazed roofs, green grilles, chimneys and ridge ornament. Appendix C identifies the standing plan and fabric.
Three-storey Grade 1 historic building. The adaptive-reuse planning process reinforces retention of the historic volume.
The planning statement records the 2025 approval for the adaptive-reuse proposal. Proposed additions are not used as building reference.
